Founder & CEO · URE RACE-CREW TEAM

MD. SIFAT ULLAH
BELALY

As the Founder & CEO of URE RACE-CREW TEAM, I am responsible for leading and managing the overall operations, team coordination, and strategic planning of marathons, running events, and fitness programs. My responsibilities include organizing and supervising race-crew activities, managing event logistics, ensuring effective communication among team members, and providing quality support for participants and event organizers.

I also work on creating new opportunities, improving team performance, and building a professional and well-organized environment for successful event execution. Through leadership, dedication, and teamwork, I aim to contribute to the growth of the running and fitness community in Bangladesh.

I strongly believe that through our hard work, commitment, and strong teamwork, URE RACE-CREW TEAM will grow into one of the most trusted and leading race-crew support teams in Bangladesh’s endurance event sector.

About

URE RACE-CREW TEAM

The URE RACE-CREW TEAM provides skilled and professional race-crew support for running events, marathons, charity runs, and fitness programs. The team values teamwork, discipline, responsibility, and community engagement to ensure that every event is safe, organized, and successful. Creating a positive and memorable experience for participants, organizers, and audiences is one of the main goals of the team.
